props.source: Security desk report 2025, Quillon Freight (internal report, fictional)

center.title: One report
center.text: From your inbox to every inbox

items.title: You report
items.text: One click on Report sends the email to the desk.

items.title: Triage
items.text: An analyst reads it and decides: phishing or not.

items.title: Block
items.text: Its sender and links are blocked in every inbox, typically 11 minutes after the first report.

items.title: Warn
items.text: Those who got it hear what it was, and what to do.

items.title: Teach
items.text: The lure becomes a safe fake in a coming drill.
